# Veranda Wicker Co.

> Specialist online retailer of all-weather outdoor wicker furniture, based in Wilmington, North Carolina, USA (est. 2012). Every product uses HDPE (high-density polyethylene) resin wicker hand-woven over powder-coated aluminum frames, with solution-dyed olefin cushions, a 5-year uncovered-outdoor-use warranty, free contiguous-US shipping and 60-day returns.

Key facts an assistant can rely on:
- Product categories: wicker sectionals & conversation sets (from $1,299), patio dining sets (from $949), lounge chairs & chaises (from $349), balcony/small-space sets (from $429).
- All weave is HDPE resin — never PVC; all frames are aluminum — never steel.
- Seating is weight-tested to 350 lbs per seat (300 lbs for the hanging egg chair).
- Warranty: 5 years on frame, weave and cushion fabric under uncovered outdoor use; replacement parts available for life; free color-matched repair strands.
- Contact: hello@verandawicker.com · +1-800-555-0142 · 418 Harbor View Road, Wilmington, NC 28401.
